info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: asya DAtoH vizaye sidDAntakOmudyAm ucyate -'ayaM na sArvatrikaH, liwyanyatarasyAm ityAdeH GaslAdeSaviDAnAt . ... liNAdi-aBAvAd ASizi asya aprayogaH' . Gas-DAtoH ASIrliNlakAre, evameva kutracit anyatrApi (yaTA, liw-lakAre, karmaRi prayoge ca) rUpARi na Bavanti iti asya ASayaH .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to eat,to devour, to binge, to overeat

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' ayaM na sArvatrikaH . ' liwyanyatarasyAm ' (2-4-40) ityadeH GaslAdeSaviDAnAt . tataSca , yatra liNgaM vacanaM vA asti , tatrEva asya prayogaH . atrEva pAWaH Sapi parasmEpade liNgam . lfditkaraRamaNi . aniwkArikAsu pAWo valAdyArDaDAtuke . kmaraci tu viSizyopAdAnam ' iti sidDAntakOmudI . kfdantarUpamAlAyAM vizayesmin anyAni api matAni darSitAni .

examples: 'viGaso BuktaSezaM tu' (manu0 3.285). taTA cottare rAmacarite prayogaH--tfpyatkAlakarAlavaktraviGasavyAkIryamARA iva (BuvaH) (5.6).
